addr: 3rd floor, #950, Bayt Towers, 12th Main Rd, opposite to Araku Coffee, Sodepur, HAL, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008, India

rev.t: I was here for the TISS Bollywood Postmortem show by Kautuk, Varun and Aadar. I had a whale of a time, loved it. I found the price of the F&B to be decent and pocket light. The staff were also good at their work. Good time overall.
